design: simple TWFE benchmark, unstacked country-year panel
treatment: first source-recorded non-reducing expansion of total paid/unpaid or paid father-specific entitlement in the common 2000-2024 catalogue
multiple_expansions: country remains post after its first mapped expansion; later changes are not separately estimated
approved_exception: each country has its own implementation year instead of a single common year
other_changes: data paths, outcome and unit variable names only
controls: no mapped qualifying expansion; may already have leave or have other policy changes
missing_policy: no zero imputation; outcome rows without known entitlement sets omitted
inference: chapter default, descriptive TWFE benchmark; not a modern staggered-adoption ATT
